dialogues.speaker: Zhuoxin
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}? It's been a while. I hope you and Ineffa are doing well.

response.speaker: Zhuoxin
response.text: After that previous mess was resolved, the Pyro Archon decided to establish a simple harbor here in response to the situation in the north. This way, there's a convenient place to welcome people coming from Nod-Krai.

response.speaker: Zhuoxin
response.text: After everything you did for me, I wanted to face up to my actions and try to do some good... even if it might not seem like much.

response.speaker: Zhuoxin
response.text: So I came here to help people who are in similar circumstances.

choices.text: And the Fatui never came looking for you?

response.speaker: Zhuoxin
response.text: The Flower-Feather Clan has been helping me keep an eye out, but it doesn't look like they plan on doing me any harm. I imagine Nod-Krai is already giving them enough trouble.

response.speaker: Zhuoxin
response.text: Or perhaps everything that happened here boiled down to the recklessness of her subordinates, and "Marionette" herself... couldn't care less about it.
